records.text: Just I wouldn't even have to see that because of common sense but thank you for sending it Tony Hill writes hi Candace I'm so happy to hear you and Kanye (Kanye West) got to catch up over the weekend when you spoke about his influence yesterday took me down memory lane I listened to the college dropout every single day in high school and it got me through a lot yeah you can always kind of remember that's the thing about music is it always brings back nostalgia and where you were at in your life and how much you have transformed since you heard that song that's why the Kid Cudi surprise it was just
